<documents>
<document id="docs-verification-letter">
AccountˆverificationˆletterˆAnˆaccountˆverificationˆletterˆconfirmsˆthatˆyouˆhaveˆanˆopenˆaccountˆwithˆus.ˆLandlords,ˆemployersˆandˆgovernmentˆofficesˆsometimesˆaskˆforˆone.ˆ##ˆGetˆaˆletterˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆAccountˆverificationˆletter.ˆTheˆPDFˆisˆreadyˆrightˆawayˆandˆshowsˆyourˆname,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆaccountˆtypeˆandˆtheˆdateˆtheˆaccountˆwasˆopened.ˆ##ˆShowingˆyourˆbalanceˆYouˆcanˆchooseˆwhetherˆtheˆletterˆincludesˆyourˆcurrentˆbalance.ˆ##ˆCustomˆlettersˆWeˆcan'tˆwriteˆcustomˆletters,ˆsignˆforms,ˆorˆfillˆinˆthird-partyˆverificationˆforms.ˆTheˆstandardˆletterˆisˆacceptedˆbyˆmostˆorganizations.ˆ##ˆClosedˆaccountsˆLettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆForˆaˆclosedˆaccount,ˆuseˆyourˆfinalˆstatement.ˆ##ˆSomeoneˆelseˆaskingˆWeˆdon'tˆconfirmˆaccountˆdetailsˆtoˆlandlords,ˆemployersˆorˆanyoneˆelseˆwhoˆcontactsˆusˆdirectly.ˆGiveˆthemˆtheˆletterˆyourself.ˆ##ˆIsˆitˆofficial?ˆYes.ˆTheˆletterˆcarriesˆaˆverificationˆcodeˆthatˆtheˆrecipientˆcanˆcheckˆonˆourˆhelpˆcenter.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-pockets">
HowˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆSavingsˆPocketsˆareˆseparateˆbalancesˆinsideˆyourˆaccountˆthatˆearnˆinterest.ˆYouˆcanˆhaveˆupˆtoˆ10ˆofˆthem,ˆeachˆwithˆitsˆownˆnameˆandˆgoal.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆpocketˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket.ˆNameˆit,ˆsetˆaˆgoalˆifˆyouˆlike,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆin.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆMovingˆmoneyˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆyourˆpocketsˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree,ˆeveryˆday.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆmanyˆtimesˆyouˆcanˆwithdrawˆfromˆaˆpocket.ˆ##ˆInterestˆAllˆyourˆpocketsˆearnˆtheˆAPYˆforˆyourˆplan:ˆ0.50%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ2.00%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ3.75%ˆonˆPremium.ˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆ##ˆSpendingˆfromˆaˆpocketˆYourˆcardˆspendsˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆnotˆfromˆpockets.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆbackˆfirst.ˆ##ˆClosingˆaˆpocketˆTapˆtheˆpocket,ˆthenˆClose.ˆAnyˆmoneyˆandˆaccruedˆinterestˆmoveˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-documents">
DocumentsˆthatˆhelpˆaˆdisputeˆTheˆrightˆdocumentsˆmakeˆaˆdisputeˆfasterˆandˆmoreˆlikelyˆtoˆsucceed.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆhelpsˆforˆeachˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆreceivedˆ-ˆOrderˆconfirmationˆshowingˆtheˆexpectedˆdeliveryˆdateˆ-ˆTrackingˆinformation,ˆifˆanyˆ-ˆYourˆmessagesˆtoˆtheˆmerchantˆaskingˆaboutˆtheˆdeliveryˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆasˆdescribedˆ-ˆTheˆproductˆlistingˆorˆdescriptionˆ-ˆPhotosˆofˆwhatˆyouˆreceivedˆ-ˆProofˆyouˆreturnedˆitˆorˆofferedˆto,ˆifˆtheˆmerchantˆaskedˆ##ˆCancelledˆsubscriptionˆstillˆchargedˆ-ˆTheˆcancellationˆconfirmation,ˆorˆaˆscreenshotˆofˆtheˆdateˆyouˆcancelledˆ-ˆTheˆmerchant'sˆcancellationˆterms,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆthemˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆUsuallyˆnothing.ˆJustˆconfirmˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorizeˆtheˆtransactionˆandˆthatˆyourˆcardˆisˆfrozenˆorˆreported.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆuploadˆOpenˆtheˆdisputeˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆtapˆAddˆdocuments.ˆPhotosˆandˆPDFsˆwork.ˆNeverˆsendˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆpasswordsˆasˆpartˆofˆaˆdispute.ˆWeˆdon'tˆneedˆthem.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
